title: Persona Development & Evaluation
summary: This module provides a comprehensive suite of tools for developing, evaluating, and demonstrating persona steering vectors for large language models. It covers the entire lifecycle from artifact generation to validation and interactive demonstrations.

nodes.label: Persona Experiment Runners
nodes.title: Persona Experiment Runners
nodes.description: Provides CLI tools for the full persona development pipeline, from artifact generation and data collection to vector extraction, steering demonstrations, and final validation.

nodes.label: Steering Demonstrations
nodes.title: Persona Steering Demonstrations
nodes.description: Offers tools to demonstrate and evaluate persona steering, including generating steered text, analyzing hidden states, and running grid-based experiments.

nodes.label: SAE Analysis Tools
nodes.title: SAE Analysis Tools
nodes.description: Provides API endpoints for analyzing Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), comparing activations between prompts, and generating snapshots for specific messages.

nodes.label: Data Generation & Rollouts
nodes.title: Data Generation & Rollouts
nodes.description: Generates conversational data through automated model rollouts and self-chat experiments, exploring persona vector influence and gate discovery.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: Underlying Language Model
nodes.description: The core large language model (e.g., Gemma) used for text generation, activation extraction, and steered responses across all persona development stages.

nodes.label: External Evaluation Services
nodes.title: AI Evaluation & Judging Services
nodes.description: External AI services (e.g., Vertex AI) used for generating artifacts, judging model responses, and evaluating coherence during persona development and validation.

nodes.label: Persona Data Artifacts
nodes.title: Persona Configuration & Vectors
nodes.description: Includes trait bundles, persona vectors, calibration data, and other structured data defining personas and their steering properties.

nodes.label: Steering API Endpoint
nodes.title: FastAPI Steering API
nodes.description: An external API endpoint that provides real-time persona steering functionality, used for benchmarking and integration.

groups.label: Persona Lifecycle Stages
groups.title: Persona Lifecycle Stages
groups.description: Modules covering the end-to-end process of persona development, from data generation and experimentation to validation.

groups.label: Analysis & Demonstration
groups.title: Analysis & Demonstration
groups.description: Modules focused on analyzing persona effects, demonstrating steering capabilities, and inspecting model internals.

groups.label: Core External Dependencies
groups.title: Core External Dependencies
groups.description: Essential external systems and data assets that the persona development and evaluation process relies upon.
